title: Authenticated SCHC DIO provenance claims independent checksum and identity checks that are absent
description: authenticated_schc_dio.json provenance says independent consumers revalidate exact checksums, source/signer binding, root AddrForKey binding, and construction bytes. python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py currently checks only outer signatures for this family; production-backed tests cannot serve as the independent oracle. Add a no-production-import check that parses the stored IPv6/ICMP/DIO envelope, validates lengths and ICMPv6 checksum, verifies SCHC dispatch + Rule255 exact payload wrapping, checks source IID against signer (including mismatch case), and checks root key/DODAG binding cases.
